shots.vo: Grok in SpecWithCode: plan, build, review.

card.title: Grok in SpecWithCode
card.subtitle: Plan, build and review one task. The plan stays in your repo.

shots.vo: In your repo, run specweave init with the generic adapter. It adds AGENTS.md and eleven SpecWeave skills.
shots.stepChip: In your repo: specweave init . --quick --adapter generic

showLines: ✓ 11 skills installed as sw-* in .claude/skills/ and .agents/skills/
steps.elide: dim … row between and after the two lines

shots.vo: Grok skips project skills in folders it doesn't trust. In the repo, run grok --trust once. Signed out? Run grok login first.
shots.stepChip: Trust the folder once: grok --trust · signed out: grok login

shots.vo: Open SpecWithCode. In the account menu, pick Settings, then Providers. Grok is off by default: click Add provider, pick Grok, existing CLI, click Next twice, then Add instance.
shots.stepChip: Settings → Providers → Add provider → Grok (existing CLI)

steps.note: the wizard was finished off camera (SERIES.md, recording plan step 7)

steps.name: Account: Demo Mac
steps.note: Settings sits in the menu under the computer name at the foot of the sidebar

steps.name: Providers
steps.note: route /settings/providers; only Codex and Claude rows show

steps.text: Add an account or configure a provider
steps.note: dialog "Add provider"; steps Provider, Identity, Config

steps.name: Grok (existing CLI)
steps.note: not the "Grok Build" ACP Registry card
Identity: Label Grok, Instance ID grok
Config: Binary path grok
toast: Grok instance 'grok' was added.
never click "Toggle account email visibility"

shots.vo: Add the repo: the plus next to Projects, Local folder, then its path. A new chat opens. Pick Grok in the model picker, and set Full access for this demo.

steps.name: Back
steps.note: leaves Settings (sidebar foot)

steps.name: Add project
steps.note: the + next to Projects
"New project" and "Personal assistant" rows sit above it
adding the folder opens a new chat; no separate New chat click
the model picker is labelled with the current model
Grok rail: Grok 4.7, Grok 4.7 Fast, Grok 4.6, Grok 4.5, Grok Build

steps.name: Runtime mode
steps.note: defaults to Supervised

shots.vo: Type a dollar sign, pick sw-increment, and describe the change. Grok writes spec.md: acceptance criteria and a task with its files and test.
shots.stepChip: $ → Sw Increment → describe the change → Enter

steps.name: Message
steps.note: placeholder "Ask for changes, send follow-ups, or attach images" on a new chat
the menu lists the 11 skills title-cased: Sw Auto … Sw Team, each tagged Project Skill

steps.text: Personal greeting: greet(name) returns "Hello, <name>!" and greet() still returns "Hello, world!". Use Ada in examples. Plan only, no code yet.

steps.note: send button aria-label "Submit message"
speed-ramped 21x in the edit (the take ran 89 s), with the Sped up chip
hold on the reply: AC-01, AC-02, T-01 with its files and npm test

shots.vo: Then send sw-do. Grok claims the task, changes the code, and runs the test. The task is marked done only when the test passes.
shots.stepChip: $ → Sw Do → claim → edit → test → done

steps.text: Do T-01, then stop. I will close the increment myself.

steps.note: speed-ramped 24x in the edit (the take ran 77 s), with the Sped up chip
expands the turn's steps
hold on Ran 3 commands: git add …, specweave task done T-01 0001-personal-greeting --run "npm test -- test/greeting.test.js", then "T-01 is complete. I will stop as requested."

shots.vo: Click Open diff to review the code, the test, and the ledger line that records who finished the task.

steps.note: on the last turn's "5 changed files" card
the done line: "by":"grok@demo" with its evidence

shots.vo: Next, sw-done verifies and closes the increment.

stepVerbs.expect: text must be visible within 20 s, else the take stops
stepVerbs.click: move the cursor to the element (role + name, or text), outline it, click
stepVerbs.clickIfPresent: click only when the element exists (optional wizard steps)
stepVerbs.hover: move the cursor to the element and hold
stepVerbs.type: type text (into a placeholder or the focused element)
stepVerbs.waitTurn: wait until the agent turn ends (no Stop button); the edit speed-ramps this span
stepVerbs.ensureOption: open a combobox and pick an option only when it does not already show it
